verdict.rationale: Swell provides a documented backend REST API with authentication, official Node/PHP libraries, and explicit support for building frontends 'with any framework,' plus a CLI and serverless functions for custom logic — all core pieces needed for a fully custom headless storefront (swell-docs-1,7,8,33,39). missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probe hits 404) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond first-party docs.
